reproduction_manifest.eval_command: GIT_PYTHON_REFRESH=quiet python3 main.py with experiments/configs/dt2_wide_rep.yaml -F experiments/runs/dt2_wide --force
reproduction_manifest.notes: Successfully reproduced DT-2 wide meta-prior KL-Divergence (0.005746 vs paper 0.0058, within CI [0.0056, 0.0060]) and Inference Time (0.0144s vs paper 0.014s, within CI [0.003, 0.0151]). Experiment 4.1 inverse-gamma prior with normal-variance likelihood. Training: 20 epochs x 100 steps x 5000 batch = 10M samples. Testing: 1000 unseen priors with 10000 KL samples each. Used single GPU (cuda:0, A100-80GB). Container required Python 3.10 compatibility fixes: patched InverseGamma for PyTorch 2.1.0, fixed Python 3.11+ subscript unpacking syntax, made SDPBackend/sdpa_kernel, NotRequired, and tabpfn imports conditional for PyTorch 2.1.0 compatibility.
reproduction_manifest.eval_output_format: KL-Divergence from stdout grep 'Posterior mean KL divergence: '; Inference Time from sacred run info.json key 'model_inference_time'
reproduction_manifest.known_levers: n_components (2->5 for DT-5), epochs (20->40+), batch_size, lr (0.005), d_model (64->128), num_layers (6->8+), dim_feedforward (256->512), use_prior_loss (True/False). Model is small (426K params) so training cost is low.
reproduction_manifest.setup_notes: Container started from fallback image docker.1ms.run/pytorch/pytorch:2.1.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-runtime. Python 3.10.13 required compatibility patches: (1) Added InverseGamma to torch.distributions via patch at /opt/conda/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/distributions/inverse_gamma_patch.py with import added to __init__.py; (2) Fixed Python 3.11+ subscript unpacking (*list inside [...]) in embeddings.py and ace_dt_morphology.py; (3) Made torch.nn.attention.SDPBackend/sdpa_kernel import conditional in train.py; (4) Changed typing.NotRequired to typing_extensions.NotRequired in distribution_transformer.py and train.py; (5) Made tabpfn import optional in test.py; (6) Lowered Python requirement in pyproject.toml from >=3.12.0 to >=3.10.0 and torch from >=2.5.0 to >=2.0.0. No pre-downloaded datasets needed - experiment generates synthetic data on-the-fly. Model checkpoint saved to /models/paper-4734/dt2_wide_model.pt.

optimization_objective.summary: Tune DT architecture to minimize KL-Divergence (posterior approximation quality) while keeping inference time competitive (Pareto trade-off). Primary metric is KL-Divergence; inference time is an antagonistic guardrail.

metrics.name: KL-Divergence
metrics.rationale: Primary quality metric from Table 1 of paper - measures how well DT approximates true Bayesian posterior. Paper reports 0.0058 ± 0.0002 for DT-2 wide meta-prior.

metrics.name: Inference Time per 1000 Problems (s)
metrics.rationale: Speed metric from Table 1. Paper reports 0.014s for DT-2. Antagonistic to KL-Divergence - larger/more components improve accuracy but slow inference. Should stay below 0.02s to remain competitive.

optimization_objective.success_policy: Primary goal: reduce KL-Divergence below baseline 0.005746. Guardrail: keep inference time below 0.02s per 1000 problems. Any KL improvement at acceptable inference cost is a win. Accept up to 2x slower if KL improves >=10%. Downstream sequential inference (Sections 4.3.1/4.3.2) is NOT in scope for optimization.
